summary: Recorded the no-commit-without-explicit-user-prompt policy in Tower instructions, Git-master instructions, durable operating preferences, current status, and L0/L1 operational memory. Exact policy wording added: "Do not create commits, check-ins, or route Git-master to commit unless the user explicitly asks for a commit/check-in." Also clarified that Git-master may still inspect status/diffs and report Git risks when requested, but creating a commit requires explicit user authorization.
work_completed: Updated Tower prompt with a Git authorization section that blocks commits or commit-routing unless the user explicitly asks for a commit/check-in.
Updated Git-master prompt and policy to prohibit commits/check-ins without explicit user authorization while preserving status/diff inspection responsibilities.
Updated docs/tower_operating_preferences.md with the durable Git and commit policy.
Updated current status and L0/L1 memory so future Tower sessions discover the policy during startup.

findings.message: Repository already contained unrelated modified/untracked Control Tower state, log, packet, and memory import artifacts; this task only changed the listed documentation and instruction files.

follow_up_recommendations: Review and accept the policy wording before any future Tower-led Git workflow assumes commit authorization.
memory_worthy: User preference: no commits or check-ins unless the user explicitly asks for a commit/check-in. Tower must not route Git-master to commit without that explicit user prompt; Git-master may still inspect status/diffs and report Git risks when requested.
